Drops meters radius column so feet is used.

Remove check_in_radius_meters and its positive-radius constraint. The model no longer validates meters or derives it from feet, so feet is only left. Only the migration references feet since it was introduced.

Down migration is reversible but will not be precise. It re-adds meters column and backfills it with feet values, rounded/floored, and satisfies the positive constraint. It cannot restore the exact pre-drop meters value.

Specs for meters derivation and the second-meters error case are removed. Invalid feet still produces a clear error, blank, whole-number, and range examples are also tested.

head_commit.message:
Import events from GetInvolved CSV or Excel files.

Adds an EventImport::Parser, Mapper, and Executor services and an EventImportsController with new/preview/confirm actions.

Only Approved rows are imported, otherwise they're skipped in the preview.

Adds events.external_reference for uniqueness. Re-imports updates the event in place. Imported events rae geocoded if possible, otherwise coordinates are blank and user is alerted.

Location pin validation is relaxed for imported events so officers can add pins after import. A flash message will tell them if it's required.

Adds request and service specs covering parsing, mapping, HTML, geocoding success/fail, and CSV import.

Adds roo gem dependency and CSV/Excel test files.

find_or_create_by! for admin and member. create! tries to insert new
rows. Unique index in the roles db prevents it. It now reuses a role
instead of creating. "member" was also changed to "Member" to match
existing code.
